integrity: Algebraic arguments establish all characteristics and arities; finite checks are corroborative. Comparisons are best-knowledge, not uniqueness certificates. Sources not located or not inspected can still contain stronger results.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the four-dimensional split local two-generator family with lambda unequal to one; sharpness applies only among noncommutative split local associative algebras. Counts require finite fields; group and scheme models work over arbitrary fields. Parameter classification is classical and not claimed novel. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Universal Heisenberg unit groups and commuting schemes in a quantum-exterior family
